program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((axis (first (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) (range 0 (rows g)))) (range 0 (cols g))))))
    (foldl (lambda (p out)
             (let ((mc (- (* 2 axis) (second p))))
               (if (and (in-bounds? (first p) mc (rows g) (cols g)) (= (at out (first p) mc) 0))
                   (set-cell out (first p) mc 8)
                   out)))
           g (find-color g 6))))
